title.hr: Očekivani godišnji gubitak (ALE) i cijena zaštite
title.en: Expected annual loss and the price of a control

concept.hr: ALE = gubitak × učestalost; zaštita vrijedi kad uklanja više nego što stoji
concept.en: ALE = loss × frequency; a control pays when it removes more than it costs

summary.hr: Zadaj rizicima gubitak i učestalost, kupi zaštite i osiguranje, prati ALE, cijenu zaštite i najgoru simuliranu godinu.
summary.en: Give risks a loss and a frequency, buy controls and insurance, watch the ALE, the cost of controls and the worst simulated year.
